name: Leiden University
header:
Leiden University
Netherlands · MSc Mathematics (Algebra, Geometry and Number Theory); subsequent employed PhD; ALGANT is a separate
consortium route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• December 1, 2026 LExS deadline is far earlier than the normal MSc deadline.
• A June graduation requires explicit use of Leiden’s late-document immigration procedure.
• LExS is a tuition contribution, not a guaranteed full living stipend.
• The ordinary Leiden MSc checklist and ALGANT consortium checklist are different applications; do not merge
referee requirements.
• Faculty availability is unverified. Broad AGNT roster checked; cryptology-only staff and emeritus faculty are
not presented as ordinary advisers. Bart de Smit has no verified recent paper in the accessible official pages.
• Bart de Smit remains a current Leiden professor, but no 2024-2026 research paper was verified; his 2019
article must not be labelled recent. Administrative duties make individual supervision confirmation especially
useful.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a UChicago mathematics BA is eligible for individual comparison with a Dutch research-university
mathematics bachelor; completion before enrolment and adequate mathematical preparation required.
Current final-year students can apply conditionally. F-1 status is not a Dutch immigration or scholarship
category. A subsequent Leiden PhD normally requires a master’s degree and a supervisor/job or separately
arranged funded route; this is not an ordinary US-style BA-to-PhD cohort. [admit] [docs] [phd] [phdapply]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose MSc Mathematics and specialisation, register through Studielink, then complete the separate uSis
application. Studielink opens October 1 in the preceding year; ULCN credentials may take two days. Prepare
the placement letter and records. Pay the application fee before processing. Scholarship applicants must
complete academic submission/payment first, allow up to three working days, then return to the scholarship
section. PhD: approach the institute or apply to an advertised vacancy before Graduate School registration.
[process] [lexs] [phdapply]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For MSc, the programme admission process does not require securing a thesis adviser first. For PhD, contact
the institute or apply to an advertised funded project. Faculty shortlist below is grouped by direct
AG/arithmetic/number-theory relevance; taking new students must be confirmed. Manjul Bhargava is listed as
a special Leiden affiliation and should not be assumed resident or available for ordinary Leiden supervision;
Lenstra and Tijdeman are emeritus. [admit] [phd] [roster]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Studielink starts the request; uSis holds the complete academic application, payment, decision and attendance
response. Admissions checks missing items after payment and targets a decision in 4-6 weeks. PhD Graduate
School registration follows institutional approval; the LUCRIS guide warns to prepare records/CV and complete
the application once, moving between tabs until final Save & Close. [process] [phdapply] [lucris]

immigration rules are standing policy. Individual 2027 PhD jobs and salaries are not yet established by this

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
September 2027: April 1, 2027 if a visa/residence permit is needed; May 15, 2027 otherwise (2027-28 brochure
plus standing programme rules). Complete uSis, not merely Studielink. The departmental page labels the
cutoff 23:59 CET; this label does not resolve April daylight-saving ambiguity. February entry standing dates:
October 15 with immigration processing, November 15 otherwise. PhD deadlines are individual vacancy
deadlines; employment can start throughout the year. [dates] [brochure] [phd]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
LExS for September 2027: December 1, 2026, with academic application and fee already submitted; exact time
zone/cutoff time not stated. This is substantially earlier than the MSc admission deadline. Do not use old
February 1 LExS advice. ALGANT uses its own application and funding process (separate dossier). [lexs]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
No recommendation letters are listed in the ordinary Mathematics MSc required-document checklist or LExS
application requirements. Therefore no public reference deadline applies to those checklists; additional
requests remain possible. PhD vacancy references and deadlines are position-specific. ALGANT is separate and
does require referees. [docs] [lexs] [phd]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If not exempt, English evidence may follow conditional admission. Immigration applicants normally satisfy
conditions by June 1; the documented late-evidence route sets July 6 for visa-plus-residence applicants, August
1 for residence-only applicants. Non-immigration applicants meet conditions before the September start.
Obtain individual confirmation if using an exception. UChicago graduates fall within the US-degree exemption
once completed. [docs] [conditions] [late] [admit]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Initial uSis supporting documents accompany the academic deadline. Normal immigration conditions deadline:
June 1, with visa documents and fees also due then. Important June-graduation exception: visa-plus-residence
applicants submit available documents/fees plus an explanation by June 1; by July 6 UChicago must directly
send certified latest grades, predicted results and expected graduation before September (plus English
evidence if required). Residence-only applicants may provide missing records/test by August 1. Final degree
evidence is still required before study starts; contact admissions if the diploma itself is issued later. [dates] [visa]
[conditions] [late]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Confirm attendance in uSis before beginning immigration processing (June 1 immigration deadline);
non-immigration applicants before programme start. uSis allows yes/no/maybe-later and changes. LExS
acceptance deadline is stated in the individual award offer, not a universal public date; results are expected
before the end of March. Tuition payment is required before starting. [process] [visa] [lexs] [lexsterms]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
MSc has no automatic stipend. LExS offers tuition contributions at five levels: €10,000, €15,000, €17,500,
€18,500 or €19,000. It is not full-cost support; substantial funds for living costs/remaining tuition are required.
The public award page does not unambiguously state whether each figure is an annual or whole-programme
amount: verify the offer. Illustrative 2026 Leiden PhD job scale: €3,204-€4,051 gross/month for 38 hours, plus
8% holiday and 8.3% year-end payments; this is not a guaranteed 2027 AG vacancy salary. [lexs] [salary]
Years of support [Standing rule]
LExS terms allow a two-year programme award for at most 24 months; second-year continuation requires 60

ECTS in the first year. Mathematics PhD employment is ordinarily four years; the cited 2026 example offers one
year initially, then three after a positive assessment. [lexsterms] [phd] [salary]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
LExS generally requires a non-EEA/non-EFTA passport and ineligibility for Dutch student finance; mathematics
is eligible. UChicago/F-1 alone does not prove citizenship eligibility. Strong prior performance, roughly top 10%,
is an indicator rather than a required official ranking certificate. PhD jobs accept international applicants
subject to immigration and vacancy requirements. [lexs] [phdapply]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
LExS is selective (approximately 25 awards against over 1,000 applications). Current terms require progress,
prohibit combining another full scholarship and require advance permission for partial awards; another
Leiden-sponsored award cannot normally be combined. Immigration still requires proof of adequate funds.
Award is tied to the programme and intake. [lexs] [lexsterms] [visa]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
Yes, LExS is a separate scholarship selection inside uSis after academic application/payment. Final scholarship
submission cannot be revised online or by email. Submit before December 1, 2026; allow the preceding
processing interval. No extra reference listed. [lexs]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
ALGANT offers separately allocated scholarships/fee reductions for a mobility master’s and must be applied to
independently. For the later PhD, institute-funded and project-funded advertised jobs are the principal route
identified by the mathematics institute. External scholarship-funded doctorates require a supervisor and
Graduate School approval; no universal amount established. [phd] [phdapply]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
Application fee €100, nonrefundable, for a foreign qualification; it covers up to three
programmes/specialisations in the same academic year. 2027-28 Mathematics tuition: non-EU/EEA institutional
rate €23,300/year; statutory eligible Dutch/EU/EEA/Swiss/Surinamese rate €2,771. Citizenship/residence
exceptions must be checked individually. The page lists €17,900 for a second Dutch master’s;
cooperation-agreement fees can differ (ALGANT). [process] [tuition]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published €100 application-fee exemptions: qualifying Dutch bachelor/current Dutch study, earlier Leiden
degree/exchange/pre-master registration, prior admission to the same programme being postponed, or
recognised Dutch refugee/asylum circumstances. The page says other reasons do not qualify; a UChicago F-1
applicant has no established waiver from the facts given. [process]

Leiden University
Netherlands · MSc Mathematics (Algebra, Geometry and Number Theory); subsequent employed PhD; ALGANT is a separate
consortium route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• December 1, 2026 LExS deadline is far earlier than the normal MSc deadline.
• A June graduation requires explicit use of Leiden’s late-document immigration procedure.
• LExS is a tuition contribution, not a guaranteed full living stipend.
• The ordinary Leiden MSc checklist and ALGANT consortium checklist are different applications; do not merge
referee requirements.
• Faculty availability is unverified. Broad AGNT roster checked; cryptology-only staff and emeritus faculty are
not presented as ordinary advisers. Bart de Smit has no verified recent paper in the accessible official pages.
• Bart de Smit remains a current Leiden professor, but no 2024-2026 research paper was verified; his 2019
article must not be labelled recent. Administrative duties make individual supervision confirmation especially
useful.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a UChicago mathematics BA is eligible for individual comparison with a Dutch research-university
mathematics bachelor; completion before enrolment and adequate mathematical preparation required.
Current final-year students can apply conditionally. F-1 status is not a Dutch immigration or scholarship
category. A subsequent Leiden PhD normally requires a master’s degree and a supervisor/job or separately
arranged funded route; this is not an ordinary US-style BA-to-PhD cohort. [admit] [docs] [phd] [phdapply]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose MSc Mathematics and specialisation, register through Studielink, then complete the separate uSis
application. Studielink opens October 1 in the preceding year; ULCN credentials may take two days. Prepare
the placement letter and records. Pay the application fee before processing. Scholarship applicants must
complete academic submission/payment first, allow up to three working days, then return to the scholarship
section. PhD: approach the institute or apply to an advertised vacancy before Graduate School registration.
[process] [lexs] [phdapply]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
For MSc, the programme admission process does not require securing a thesis adviser first. For PhD, contact
the institute or apply to an advertised funded project. Faculty shortlist below is grouped by direct
AG/arithmetic/number-theory relevance; taking new students must be confirmed. Manjul Bhargava is listed as
a special Leiden affiliation and should not be assumed resident or available for ordinary Leiden supervision;
Lenstra and Tijdeman are emeritus. [admit] [phd] [roster]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Studielink starts the request; uSis holds the complete academic application, payment, decision and attendance
response. Admissions checks missing items after payment and targets a decision in 4-6 weeks. PhD Graduate
School registration follows institutional approval; the LUCRIS guide warns to prepare records/CV and complete
the application once, moving between tabs until final Save & Close. [process] [phdapply] [lucris]

Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit 2027-28 tuition and brochure plus current LExS deadline December 1, 2026; routine uSis, English and
immigration rules are standing policy. Individual 2027 PhD jobs and salaries are not yet established by this
dossier. [brochure] [tuition] [lexs] [phd]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
September 2027: April 1, 2027 if a visa/residence permit is needed; May 15, 2027 otherwise (2027-28 brochure
plus standing programme rules). Complete uSis, not merely Studielink. The departmental page labels the
cutoff 23:59 CET; this label does not resolve April daylight-saving ambiguity. February entry standing dates:
October 15 with immigration processing, November 15 otherwise. PhD deadlines are individual vacancy
deadlines; employment can start throughout the year. [dates] [brochure] [phd]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
LExS for September 2027: December 1, 2026, with academic application and fee already submitted; exact time
zone/cutoff time not stated. This is substantially earlier than the MSc admission deadline. Do not use old
February 1 LExS advice. ALGANT uses its own application and funding process (separate dossier). [lexs]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
No recommendation letters are listed in the ordinary Mathematics MSc required-document checklist or LExS
application requirements. Therefore no public reference deadline applies to those checklists; additional
requests remain possible. PhD vacancy references and deadlines are position-specific. ALGANT is separate and
does require referees. [docs] [lexs] [phd]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
If not exempt, English evidence may follow conditional admission. Immigration applicants normally satisfy
conditions by June 1; the documented late-evidence route sets July 6 for visa-plus-residence applicants, August
1 for residence-only applicants. Non-immigration applicants meet conditions before the September start.
Obtain individual confirmation if using an exception. UChicago graduates fall within the US-degree exemption
once completed. [docs] [conditions] [late] [admit]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Initial uSis supporting documents accompany the academic deadline. Normal immigration conditions deadline:
June 1, with visa documents and fees also due then. Important June-graduation exception: visa-plus-residence
applicants submit available documents/fees plus an explanation by June 1; by July 6 UChicago must directly
send certified latest grades, predicted results and expected graduation before September (plus English
evidence if required). Residence-only applicants may provide missing records/test by August 1. Final degree
evidence is still required before study starts; contact admissions if the diploma itself is issued later. [dates] [visa]
[conditions] [late]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Confirm attendance in uSis before beginning immigration processing (June 1 immigration deadline);
